prompt: Create a breathtaking cinematic fantasy scene titled “The Painter Who Finished the Sky.” At sunset, a lone artist stands high on the rooftop of an old European city, viewed mostly from behind, holding a wooden painter’s palette in one hand and a fine paintbrush raised toward the sky in the other. Beside him rises an enormous antique wooden canvas frame, several times taller than the artist. But there is no ordinary canvas inside it—the frame is mysteriously connected directly to reality itself. Create a dramatic visual transformation across the scene. On the left side, the world is unfinished: cold, desaturated and rainy. Heavy charcoal storm clouds cover the sky, rain falls over monochrome historic buildings, wet rooftops reflect dim light, balconies are empty and the entire city feels quiet and lifeless. Exactly where the artist’s brush touches the sky, reality begins transforming. A luminous burst of golden paint-like energy spreads naturally outward from the brushstroke. Dark clouds gradually become magnificent glowing sunset clouds in gold, amber, peach and soft blue. Color flows from the sky down through the city as though reality itself is being painted. Historic buildings regain warm natural colors. Windows begin glowing. Flowers bloom across balconies. Green vines appear along old stone walls. Birds emerge naturally from the painted sky and fly into the real world. Warm sunlight pours dramatically through the streets below and reflects across rain-soaked cobblestones. The right half of the city is now completely transformed into an extraordinary golden-hour world filled with warmth, life and beauty, while the far left remains cold and monochrome. The boundary between the two worlds should feel magical and organic—not like a simple split-screen effect. Individual brushstrokes, particles of light and subtle trails of pigment should visibly transition into real clouds, architecture, flowers and sunlight. Far below, small groups of people have stopped in the streets and on balconies, looking upward in wonder as they realize the sky and city are being transformed above them. The artist is carefully painting one final tiny unfinished patch of darkness near the top of the sky. Composition: epic vertical cinematic framing, artist prominent in the foreground, enormous frame creating strong visual geometry, sprawling European city extending deep into the background, dramatic sense of scale and atmospheric perspective. Lighting: spectacular golden-hour sunlight contrasted against cool storm light, volumetric rays, wet reflections, subtle mist, realistic atmospheric haze. Style: sophisticated cinematic fantasy realism, photorealistic textures, emotionally powerful visual style.

promptZh: 创作一个名为“绘就苍穹的画师”的震撼电影感奇幻场景。在黄昏时分，一位 孤独的艺术家 站在 古老欧洲城市 的屋顶高处，背影示人，一手拿着木制调色板，另一只手将一支精致的画笔指向天空。在他身旁矗立着一个巨大的古董木制画框，比艺术家本人高出数倍。但这并非普通的画布——画框神秘地直接连接着现实世界。请在场景中呈现戏剧性的视觉转变。画面左侧，世界尚未完成：寒冷、褪色且阴雨连绵。厚重的炭灰色风暴云笼罩着天空，雨水落在单调的古老建筑上，湿漉漉的屋顶反射着微弱的光线，阳台上空无一人，整座城市显得寂静而死气沉沉。就在艺术家画笔触及天空的地方，现实开始发生蜕变。一团发光的金色颜料状能量从笔触中自然向外扩散。乌云逐渐变成壮丽的金色、琥珀色、桃红色和柔和蓝色的黄昏云彩。色彩从天空流淌而下，穿过城市，仿佛现实本身正在被重新绘制。古老的建筑恢复了温暖的自然色调。窗户开始闪烁光芒。阳台上鲜花盛开。古老的石墙上长出了绿藤。鸟儿从画出的天空中自然浮现，飞入现实世界。温暖的阳光戏剧性地洒在下方的街道上，映照在雨水浸湿的鹅卵石路面上。城市右半部分现已完全转变为一个充满温暖、生命与美丽的非凡“黄金时刻”世界，而远处的左侧依然保持着寒冷与单色调。两个世界之间的边界应呈现出神奇且有机的过渡感，而非简单的分屏效果。细腻的笔触、光点和微妙的颜料痕迹应清晰地转化为真实的云朵、建筑、花朵和阳光。在远处的下方，街道和阳台上的行人停下脚步，惊叹地抬头仰望，意识到天空和城市正在他们上方发生蜕变。艺术家正专注地涂抹着天空顶部最后一块未完成的黑暗区域。构图：史诗般的垂直电影构图，艺术家位于前景显眼位置，巨大的画框营造出强烈的视觉几何感，广阔的欧洲城市向背景深处延伸，具有宏大的尺度感和大气透视感。光影：壮观的“黄金时刻”阳光与冷色调风暴光线形成对比，体积光，湿润的反射，微妙的薄雾，写实的大气朦胧感。风格：精致的电影感奇幻写实主义，照片级真实纹理，极具情感冲击力的视觉风格。
